title: System Settings
subtitle: Manage runtime reminder and notification settings for the current server.
reminderDescription: Control when expiration reminders are generated.
notifyDescription: Manage Feishu delivery for expiration reminders.
reminderHint: The scheduler uses these values as the effective runtime reminder configuration.
notifyEnabledHint: Notifications require a configured Feishu webhook.
webhookHint: Leave the input empty to keep the existing webhook. Use the clear action to remove it.
webhookClearPending: Webhook will be cleared after save.
webhookReplacePending: A new webhook will replace the current one after save.
errorConflict: Settings were updated by someone else. Refresh and try again.
notSavedYet: Using startup defaults. No runtime settings have been saved yet.
